metrics.description: Accepted records as a share of all records a source delivered in the window, rejected included. A first-class metric rather than an operational statistic, because that is what lets a data-quality gap suppress a business gap through the same machinery.
metrics.name: Data completeness

metrics.description: The share of manual stock checks where what a person counted differs from what the system believed, measured against the most recent inventory snapshot taken at or before the count. This is the primary metric behind the Stock Truth Gap.
metrics.name: Stock discrepancy rate

metrics.description: Total units the system believed were present but a person could not find. Counts only positive discrepancies: a surplus is a different problem with a different cause, and netting the two against each other hides both.
metrics.name: Stock units missing
